ingest.note: Receives transcribed text from STT. GenerateContent streaming API.

egress.note: Streams text tokens to TTS. Use stream=True for low-latency first-token.

interruption.description: On interruption, cancel the in-flight streaming generation. Gemini's streaming API supports cancellation.
interruption.code_hint: Pipecat: GoogleLLMService handles this via InterruptionFrame. LiveKit: inference.LLM handles cancellation. Custom: close the streaming response.

potholes.note: Gemini 2.5 Flash excels at code-mixed languages (Hinglish, Spanglish). Preferred for Indian-language voice agents.
1M token context window means conversation history rarely needs truncation. Still implement summarization for calls >1 hour.
